feeds_service


October 31, 2026


From another sellout of our pink items to the incredible support from Rider Nation, we're grateful for everyone who helped make this year's Pink Game so special. For 15 years, the Cameco Riders Touchdown for Dreams program has brought together our partners - the[Saskatchewan Roughriders](https://facebook.com/11693281540) and the[Cancer Foundation of Saskatchewan](https://facebook.com/553284501770606) - to create unforgettable experiences for women living with a life-threatening cancer diagnosis. Together, we've now helped grant 119 dreams, each one made possible through the generosity of fans, volunteers, partners and supporters who continue to show up and make a difference.[#TD4D](https://facebook.com/hashtag/TD4D) #ThinkPink[#RiderNation](https://facebook.com/hashtag/RiderNation)
